name: lifeline-mesh
description: End-to-end encrypted emergency messaging. Offline-first. No server required.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix crypto && npm install --prefix tools
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run check:compat && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:crypto && npm run test:vectors
scripts.test:integration: node tests/integration/ble-crypto.test.js && node tests/integration/group-messaging.test.js && node tests/integration/mesh-router.test.js && node tests/integration/ble-mesh-relay.test.js && node tests/integration/mesh-router-phase2.test.js && node tests/integration/app-runtime-mesh.test.js

author: Lifeline Mesh Contributors
